method.horizonMeaning: Each tested horizon is the Sweet evaluation/search horizon. Path AUC and terminal utility are measured only through that Soul value.
method.searchSemantics: Per-seed deterministic Width-4 continuation using production future+path-history dedupe and production Pareto retention primitives.
method.adaptiveRule: 4000/4400/5200/6800 first; 10000 if needed; then +6400 coarse steps only when some crossover has begun but not all requested crossover types are known.
method.scoreCrossoverDefinition: lost-high-velocity representative Sweet Path Score >= sweet-retained-1 representative Sweet Path Score
method.paretoCrossoverDefinition: at least one lost-high-velocity frontier candidate survives the pairwise Path/End Pareto union against sweet-retained-1
method.retentionCrossoverDefinition: at least one lost-high-velocity frontier candidate survives actual Width-4 retention over the pooled five-seed frontier candidates
